summary: This note describes Fox Sports West and Prime Ticket, two American regional sports networks owned by The Walt Disney Company that operate as Fox Sports Networks affiliates. The channels carry regional professional and collegiate sports in California, with a focus on professional teams in the Greater Los Angeles area. Their general offices and studios are based at the Staples Center in Downtown Los Angeles.
one_line: Fox Sports West and Prime Ticket are Disney-owned regional sports networks covering California sports, mainly Greater Los Angeles pro teams.
